name: Oregon Wire
old_description: At Oregon Wire we invest ourselves in being the wire manufacturer that does it right. We’re not just a supplier, we’re a partner you can trust and depend on. We also make sure we’re easy to work with, and have a customer service team that can get you what you need, when you need it.
about:
Oregon Wire was established in 1973 in Portland, Oregon, as an American manufacturer of wire products and agricultural solutions. The company has operated from its Portland base for over five decades, building a reputation for honesty and integrity in the steel wire supply industry.

The company produces a range of wire products including custom wire forms, trellis systems for commercial growers, baling wire for recycling operations, wire mesh and reinforcement products for construction, and wreath frames, floral wire, and garden supports for the wreath and garden market. Oregon Wire operates a manufacturing facility in Portland and maintains a network of custom wire form manufacturers to fulfill specialized projects. Specific facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not publicly disclosed.

Oregon Wire serves commercial growers, recycling facilities, construction contractors, industrial manufacturers, and both professional and hobbyist customers in the wreath and garden segment. The company supplies trellis systems and plant supports to growers, galvanized and black annealed baling wire to recycling operations, and durable wire mesh to construction projects. Its industrial wire solutions address manufacturing and packaging needs.

The company emphasizes flexibility, offering small-quantity orders, local pickup, warehouse services, and extended payment terms. It prioritizes locally sourced, American-made steel and recycled materials, and its customer service team provides updates on inventory, production schedules, and deliveries. Oregon Wire cites its decades of supply chain expertise as a differentiator, helping customers with cost control and inventory management.

name: Oregon and A to Z Auto Wrecking
old_description: Serving Portland, Oregon since 1937, Oregon Auto Wrecking is a one-stop shop for all your recycled automotive needs. We sell rebuilt transmissions, transfer cases, and more, plus new and aftermarket parts. Recycled auto parts are the smart and green option, as they are all quality-tested before sale, reduce waste, and are a fraction of the cost of parts from other automotive parts retailers! Plus they're backed by our guarantee including 30-day, 60-day, 90-day, and extended warranties.
about:
Oregon & A to Z Auto Wrecking has served the Portland, Oregon area since its founding in 1937. The business began as a local auto wrecking operation and has grown into a full-service automotive recycling and repair facility.

Today the company offers auto recycling, auto repair, and a comprehensive inventory of recycled and aftermarket parts. Core offerings include rebuilt transmissions, transfer cases, differential assemblies, and a wide range of electrical and mechanical components such as wiring harnesses, axle assemblies, and 4x4 parts. The facility operates a nationwide parts location service and ships via FedEx, UPS, USPS, and regional freight carriers, while providing free delivery to local repair shops and salvage yards. In-house repair capabilities cover gear ratio changes and steering column work.

The customer base spans independent automotive repair shops, salvage yards, and individual buyers across the Northwest and nationally. The company identifies itself as a supplier of 4x4 parts in the region and serves the automotive repair and recycling sectors.

Oregon & A to Z Auto Wrecking promotes recycled parts as a cost-effective and environmentally responsible alternative, noting that all components are quality-tested before sale and backed by warranties of 30, 60, or 90 days with extended options available. A sales staff with more than 15 years of experience in the auto recycling industry assists customers in locating specific parts.

name: Oriole Textile Co.
old_description: Established in 1929, Oriole Textile has emerged as a leading wholesaler of fabrics catering to an extensive array of clients worldwide. With over eight decades of experience in the industry, we have honed our expertise in providing superior quality wholesale fabrics to our customers. Our wide range of over 80 high-quality fabrics has earned the trust of discerning clients from various markets and industries. Our clientele encompasses a diverse range of businesses, including fabric stores, bridal shops, dressmakers, party coordinators, florists, event planners, dress manufacturers, and many others. At Oriole Textile, we strive to offer an exceptional customer experience with our extensive product range, competitive pricing, and efficient delivery services. Trust us to be your one-stop-shop for all your wholesale fabric needs.
about:
Oriole Textile Co. operates from New York City’s garment district, where it has been based since its founding in 1929 by Samuel Siegel. The business passed to his son Walter Siegel, then to grandson Mark Siegel, who has led the company for 50 years, and now includes great‑grandson Ron Siegel, making it a fourth‑generation family‑owned enterprise.

The company wholesales more than 80 fabric lines from its showrooms and warehouse, covering categories such as satin, tulle, bengaline, lining, taffeta, poplin, organza, chiffon, crepe, lace, lame, velvet, broadcloth, brocades, knits, sequins, shantung, tricot knits, fire‑retardant fabrics, and prints. It offers color‑card sampling and emphasizes quick order turnaround.

Customers include over‑the‑counter fabric stores, bridal shops, dressmakers, party coordinators, florists, event planners, decorators, bridesmaid manufacturers, and dress manufacturers. The firm serves both small independent shops and larger apparel producers seeking bridal, formal, and party fabrics.

Oriole Textile cites its multi‑generational legacy of honor and integrity, competitive pricing, and exceptional customer service as differentiators. It also highlights a practice of regularly introducing new collections to stay ahead of industry trends.

name: Orlando Metal Fabrication
old_description: Orlando Metal Fabrication is located in Orlando, Florida, specializes in custom metal fabrication for both commercial and residential projects. Government and Private sector partners choose OMF for the custom metal fabrication projects. You can find OMF at 11516 Satellite Boulevard, Orlando, Florida 32837.
about:
Orlando Metal Fabrication was founded in 2005 in Orlando, Florida. The company began by producing parts for an OEM construction equipment manufacturer and later expanded its capabilities to serve a broader customer base.

The shop operates a 20,000-square-foot facility offering precision cutting (waterjet and plasma), precision bending (CNC press brake), and precision welding (MIG and TIG with AWS-certified welders). Additional services include design and drafting, machining, punching, pipe and sheet rolling, assembly, and a range of finishes such as powder coating, painting, zinc plating, cadmium plating, hot-dip galvanizing, and anodizing.

Customers span commercial and residential construction, government agencies, private-sector OEMs, and other recognizable companies. The firm’s early work for a construction equipment OEM remains a reference point for its ability to handle specialized fabrication requirements.

Orlando Metal Fabrication emphasizes a five-step quality control process aligned with ISO 9001 and AS9100 standards, providing dimensional verification and material certification on request. Its stated mission is to build lasting relationships by exceeding customer expectations for workmanship and delivery.

name: Oshkosh Airport Products
old_description: Today, Oshkosh Corporation is revered as a leading designer and manufacturer of the world's toughest specialty trucks, truck bodies and access equipment. No one understands extreme conditions like Oshkosh, which is why no one builds fire and emergency apparatus, defense vehicles and commercial and access equipment better.
about:
Oshkosh Airport Products is based in Neenah, Wisconsin, and operates as a division of Oshkosh Corporation. The business focuses on the design and manufacture of aircraft rescue and firefighting (ARFF) vehicles for airport operators worldwide.

The company produces the Striker® line of ARFF trucks, including the Striker Volterra® electric variant, along with stock ARFF trucks for immediate delivery. Its product portfolio features proprietary technologies such as the ECO EFP™ foam system, K-Factor™ agent proportioning, ClearSky Intelligence™ telematics, the Snozzle® high-reach extendable turret, and the Tak-4® independent suspension. Support is delivered through a dealer network that the company describes as the largest in the airport industry, providing training, parts, and aftermarket service backed by OEM-limited warranties. Over 250 service documents are available for technical reference.

Primary customers are municipal and commercial airports, as well as government agencies that procure through cooperative purchasing programs including HGAC, Sourcewell, NPPGov, the Florida Sheriffs Association, and Ohio Buys. The trucks are built to meet the demanding performance requirements of ARFF operations at airports of all sizes.

Oshkosh Airport Products emphasizes its dealer network scale, factory-backed warranties, and a suite of integrated innovations—from electric drivetrains to advanced telematics—as the factors that differentiate its offering in the ARFF market.

name: Outokumpu
old_description: Americas most technically advanced stainless steel mill, Outokumpu Calvert offers a comprehensive product portfolio combined with industry-leading technical support and services. The mill is now adding ferritic grades to its already well-established portfolio, perfectly suited to American manufacturing. Download the ferritic stainless steels datasheet below.
about:
Outokumpu Calvert operates a fully integrated stainless steel mill in Calvert, Alabama. The facility is owned by Outokumpu Stainless USA, LLC, a subsidiary of the global Outokumpu group. While the mill draws on more than a century of stainless steel expertise dating to the invention of the material, the Calvert site itself was developed as a state-of-the-art production hub for the Americas market.

The mill performs all primary steelmaking steps on site – melting, casting, hot rolling, annealing and pickling, and cold rolling – along with finishing lines that provide polishing, slitting, and cut-to-length services. It produces hot‑rolled and cold‑rolled coil, strip, sheet, and plate across four product families: Moda (ferritic grades for mildly corrosive environments), Core (austenitic and ferritic grades for medium corrosion), Supra (grades for highly corrosive environments), and Forta (high‑strength grades enabling weight reduction). A coil service center network supports tailored finishing and logistics.

The mill serves automotive and transportation (exhaust systems, chassis components, decorative trim), chemical and petrochemical processing (sour‑gas components, high‑temperature equipment), food and beverage, tank manufacturing, infrastructure (bridge structures, floodgates, rebar), machine building, energy, pulp and paper, and tube manufacturing. Specific applications include rocket engine parts, sugar‑industry equipment, sinks and deep‑drawn products, and structural components for bridges.

Outokumpu positions Calvert as the most technically advanced stainless steel mill in the Americas, emphasizing its fully integrated flow, progressive steelmaking technology, and industry‑technical support. The addition of ferritic grades expands the portfolio for U.S. manufacturing, and the facility’s operational excellence was recognized with a 2018 Steel Excellence Award from American Metal Market.

name: Owen Steel Company - Fabrication - DE
old_description: Owen Steel was founded in Columbia, South Carolina in 1936. Over the past 90 years, we've grown from a regional fabricator into one of the country's premier structural steel contractors. The company has changed a lot since 1936. The commitment to doing the work right hasn't.
about:
Owen Steel Company was founded in 1936 in Columbia, South Carolina, and has since grown from a regional fabricator into a major structural steel contractor with fabrication plants in Columbia, SC, and Wilmington, DE. The company is headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware.

The company provides end-to-end structural steel services, including sales and contracting, project management, engineering and detailing, fabrication, quality assurance, and procurement. Its Columbia facility spans over 440,000 square feet under cranes on a 27-acre site, with single-piece lifting capacity exceeding 70 tons. A second plant in Wilmington, DE, serves the Mid-Atlantic and New York markets. All phases—estimating, engineering, procurement, fabrication, and delivery—are managed in-house by a dedicated project delivery team.

Owen Steel serves healthcare, education, transportation, government, commercial, and industrial sectors. Recent projects include the NYU Langone Medical Center Energy Building, Bronx Criminal Courthouse, John Jay College, Temple University, USC Darla Moore School of Business, VA Hospital in Detroit, World Trade Center Memorial & Museum, Washington D.C. Convention Center, and the West Virginia Meadow River Bridge.

The firm emphasizes its integrated approach—fewer handoffs, early problem-solving, and single-point accountability—as a key differentiator. It holds AISC certifications for Standard Steel Building Structures and Major Steel Bridges with Fracture Critical and Sophisticated Paint Endorsements, and maintains a quality program designed to ensure steel arrives at the project site correct and on schedule.

name: Owen Suter's Fine Furniture
old_description: Founded by Richmond native Owen Suter, the company was built on a simple philosophy: produce quality over quantity, create furniture that lasts for generations, and proudly make every piece in America. Each piece is handcrafted in our Richmond workshop using time-honored construction techniques and the finest hardwoods.
about:
Owen Suter's Fine Furniture was founded in 1986 by Richmond native Owen Suter in Richmond, Virginia. The company continues a six-generation family tradition of fine American furniture making and remains family-owned, operating a workshop and showroom in the same city.

The firm handcrafts neo-classical Americana furniture using time-honored construction techniques and solid hardwoods such as cherry, mahogany, and walnut. Production takes place in a factory located behind the showroom, where each piece is built to order. The operation emphasizes quality over quantity, with no publicly disclosed headcount or volume metrics.

The company serves residential customers directly through its showroom and online store, providing beds (low-post and poster styles), dining tables, and other heirloom pieces. Testimonials reference buyers from Virginia, Ohio, Georgia, and New York, illustrating a national reach despite the local production base.

The founding philosophy centers on producing furniture that lasts for generations, proudly made in America. The company differentiates itself through generational craftsmanship, American-sourced materials, and direct owner involvement in ensuring customer satisfaction.

name: Ozark Integrated Circuits, Inc.
old_description: Alpha Space Test & Research Alliance, LLC (Houston, TX) is a pioneer of commercial Space Testing as a Service (STaaS). The company owns and operates the MISSE platform for external orbital testing of a wide range of technologies including powered electronics, solar cells, and materials.  With a roughly six-month cadence of launches and experiment returns, customers can rapidly advance the readiness level of their active or passive technology in low Earth orbit at an affordable price.  Alpha Space was founded in 2015 and is a minority woman owned business.
about:
Ozark Integrated Circuits, Inc. was founded in 2011 in Fayetteville, Arkansas. The company is led by CEO Matt Francis, who also serves on the IEEE Board.

The company designs and manufactures rugged computing platforms under the XNode® brand, engineered to operate at temperatures of 200°C and beyond. Using advanced manufacturing and rapid customization, Ozark IC produces small, lightweight, cost-effective modules such as the UV-100, a UV sensing platform that was flown to the International Space Station in 2019 and achieved Technology Readiness Level 9.

Ozark IC serves aerospace, energy, industrial, and space sectors. Its UV-100 modules have been tested in low-Earth orbit on the ISS, and the company participates in events such as the 2025 Paris Air Show. The XNode® family addresses applications ranging from downhole energy exploration to satellite systems.

The firm differentiates itself by bringing computing to extreme environments where conventional electronics fail. Its modular platform approach enables rapid adaptation, and the UV-100's flight heritage demonstrates reliability in space.

name: Ozark Trailer Sales & MFG
old_description: Founded in 2009, Ozark Trailer Sales began as a family vision built on faith, hard work, and service. What started small has grown through dedication, perseverance, and a commitment to doing what is right.
about:
Ozark Trailer Sales & MFG operates from Harrison, Arkansas, where it was founded in 2009 as a family-owned venture rooted in Christian values. The business began with a vision built on faith, hard work, and service, growing steadily through dedication and a commitment to doing what is right.

The company manufactures its own line of Ozark-branded trailers — including deckover, cargo/enclosed, dump, equipment, hay hauler, roll-off, tilt, and utility models — and also fabricates custom builds. Beyond trailers, it sells truck beds, metal buildings, shipping containers, farm implements, and Bad Boy zero-turn mowers. A service shop handles repairs and maintenance, while rental and used-trailer options round out the offering.

Customers span agriculture, construction, transportation, and landscaping sectors. Farmers purchase hay haulers and implements; contractors use equipment and deckover trailers; landscapers buy Bad Boy mowers; and individual owners seek utility and tilt trailers. The shop has serviced everything from a 22-foot tilt-bed trailer to snow pushers and tractor-cutter combinations.

The founders say their Christian principles — honesty, integrity, and respect — guide every decision. They emphasize treating each customer like family, building relationships on trust and care, and standing behind their products with a "Built Ozark Tough" promise.
